note: One row per link from a Georgia expectation to a Common Core code. match says how the Georgia code relates to the Common Core code: same (same skill; small range or wording differences noted), broader (the Georgia code asks for more), narrower (the Georgia code is one part of it), partly (they overlap and each has something the other lacks). Standards link through their expectations; expectations with no Common Core counterpart have no row. A note names the Common Core grade when it differs.
